kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller
Accessing nested property preferences.preferences without null check; throws if parent() returns object lacking preferences property
Telemetry capture errors are silently swallowed with no logging, masking bugs in observability code even though the catch comment explains non-blocking intent.
Presigned URL TTL (900 seconds) is hardcoded; should be a constant or environment-configurable
Function returns result.rows[0] without checking if array has elements; all callers access properties on potentially undefined value
